description: The Angular radios are checked through a property binding only and the component does not listen for the form reset event. subject: link
title: Angular hw-link hides its anchor: attributes are not forwarded and RouterLink causes a full page reload
description: HwLinkComponent renders the anchor inside its template and binds only href, target, rel, variant, current and disabled. (1) aria-label, hreflang, download and class written on <hw-link> stay on the host; the anchor's accessible name stayed 'Attrs' where React and Vue expose 'Named link'. (2) There is no external input (React and Vue have one). In an Angular application such as the new guide, hw-link cannot be used for in-app navigation.

subject: field
title: Angular hw-field cannot wrap Hawiyah controls; hint, error and required are not connected to the projected control
description: React and Vue Field provide a context that gives a nested TextField/Select/NumberField its id, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and required. Angular hw-field only projects content. Wrapping an hw-text-field in hw-field leaves the input without required, aria-describedby and aria-invalid although the Field shows a required marker and an error, adds a second empty label, and produces a duplicate id when both carry a hint (fn2-hint). The Angular README documents that hw-field takes a native control and that description ids must be connected by hand, so this is a documented limitation, but it means the Field + TextField composition used in the React and Vue guide examples has no Angular equivalent (the Angular example uses a raw <input> with manual bindings).

fix: Add an open prop (v-model:open) to Vue; add open input plus openChange/queryChange outputs to Angular; add an open-change event to vanilla.

subject: pin-input
title: Pasting a formatted one-time code silently loses digits (maxlength truncates before normalisation)
description: Every adapter sets maxlength to the code length on the native input and only strips separators after the browser has applied it. Pasting "123 456" yields "12345"; pasting Arabic-Indic "٤٥٦-١٢٣" yields "45612". The user ends up with a wrong code and no message.
expected: Guide pin-input lifecycle (apps/playground/src/component-expanded-guides.ts:106): "Input and paste normalize digits to ASCII and remove non-digits"; a 6-digit code pasted with a separator should become "123456".
fix: Do not set native maxlength (keep pattern/validation), or intercept paste/beforeinput to normalise the full pasted text before truncating to length.
repro: node <scratch>/audit/work/rich-inputs/run-all.cjs vanilla,react,vue,angular en ltr light (and ar rtl dark); output <scratch>/audit/work/rich-inputs/out/run-all.en-ltr-light.vanilla_react_vue_angular.json and <scratch>/audit/work/rich-inputs/out/run-all.ar-rtl-dark.vanilla_react_vue_angular.json — real clipboard paste: pin.pasteSpaced "12345", pin.pasteArDashed "45612" in vanilla, react, vue and angular; keyboard.insertText("12-34-56") gives "1234".
verifierNote: Read vanilla/src/controls.ts:117-121, react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:66-69, vue/src/controls.ts:~500, angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:161-162; guide apps/playground/src/component-expanded-guides.ts:106. Ran verify.cjs: real clipboard paste (navigator.clipboard.writeText + ControlOrMeta+V) into a length-6 PIN in all four adapters. Identical in vanilla, React, Vue and Angular (maxlength=6): paste '123456' -> 123456; '123 456' -> 12345; '12-34-56' -> 1234; '١٢٣٤٥٦' -> 123456; '٤٥٦-١٢٣' -> 45612; insertText '12-34-56' -> 1234. Native maxlength truncates the pasted text before the adapters strip separators. Contradicts the guide lifecycle 'Input and paste normalize digits to ASCII and remove non-digits'. The truncated value fails the [0-9]{6} pattern, so it is caught on validation rather than submitted, hence P1 not P0.
